documents.title: Privacy notice
documents.status: Privacy notice for Australian commercial accounts, Marketplace transactions and eligible seller-proceeds withdrawal requests. Current service availability is shown in your account.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: Docked is operated by Ginty United Investments Pty Ltd, ABN 78 606 187 106. Contact support@docked.com.au about privacy, access, correction, deletion or a complaint.

sections.title: Account and gameplay information
sections.text:
We handle account identifiers, email, profile information, eligibility attestations, country/state, consent records, sessions and security information to operate and protect your account. Optional community posts, images, comments, reactions and follows are handled according to their audience, privacy and moderation settings. Do not send passwords, verification codes, payment-card details or identity documents to support.

We record packs, cards, serials, ownership, credits, purchases, refunds, fantasy entries and results to deliver the service, prevent duplicate fulfilment and resolve disputes. A historical shared-card snapshot can remain a record of the original post after the card changes owner; it is not proof of current ownership.

sections.title: Phone verification and processing
sections.text:
For public Australian account use, we require verification of an Australian mobile number. We use the number to establish control of that number, link one verified number to one Docked account, and reduce duplicate accounts and abuse. This does not establish that a person owns only one number or prove Australian residency. Your number is not displayed on your profile. Docked does not use verification numbers for marketing or sell them.

Supabase Auth stores the account's phone number, verification status and related authentication information. Twilio receives the destination number and verification message to deliver it through telecommunications providers. Verification messages contain a short-lived code. Enter the code only in Docked; do not give it to support or another person. Docked does not request access to your contacts or SMS inbox for verification. Twilio also processes delivery records and communications metadata for its own service operations, security, abuse prevention, service improvement and legal obligations under its published terms.

sections.title: Existing users and account recovery
sections.text:
At the end of the private beta, ordinary beta accounts are retired. Returning testers register new accounts themselves, verify their email and Australian mobile again, and accept the commercial notices. The original email and phone may be reused after retirement is verified, but the new account has a new identity and cannot retrieve the old account’s assets. Australian eligibility requirements apply; a private overseas tester exception does not carry forward.

The two retained Owners keep their existing accounts for Owner administration, with individual MFA. They start commercial participation with no usable beta credits, cards, packs, lineups or other beta advantages. Administrative status does not provide free commercial assets or payment exemptions.

Historical beta transactions, TEST receipts, refunds, recovery holds, card issuance, serials, ownership and consent evidence remain restricted records for their documented purposes. Retiring access does not reset lifetime card supply or make historical cards available for reissue. It does not create a new acceptance of commercial terms. Contact support before the notified transition if you believe a specific existing entitlement needs review.

A phone number does not replace your password, verified email or enrolled authenticator. Possession of a reassigned number alone never transfers another account, cards or credits. For loss or changes, contact support@docked.com.au. Account export and deletion requests remain available without completing phone verification.

sections.title: Social content and support
sections.text:
Posts, comments, reactions, follows, community memberships, optional images and shared-card snapshots are processed to provide social features. Visibility follows audience, privacy, blocking and moderation controls. Other members may copy content you share. Historical card-post snapshots do not prove current ownership. Reports, internal moderation notes, private preferences and authentication records are not ordinary public posts.

Support receives the messages and information you provide. Do not email passwords, payment-card details, verification links, identity documents or full bank-account details. Complete withdrawal identity checks only through the secure verification flow opened from your authenticated Docked account.

sections.title: Purchases
sections.text: Google processes Android checkout and payment-method details. Docked verifies purchase references, product/order identifiers, account binding, region, amounts, purchase status and refunds on its server. We do not receive your full payment-card number from this integration. Purchase tokens are encrypted server-side and are not stored in browser storage or sent as analytics events. Google notifications trigger verification rather than directly changing balances. Purchase and refund evidence is not public profile data. Google processes information under its own privacy terms.

sections.title: Service providers and overseas processing
sections.text:
Docked uses Supabase for authentication/database services, Vercel for hosting, Twilio for verification SMS and configured account/support email providers. Supabase's selected database region is Australia; providers may process information outside Australia, including in the United States and Singapore for delivery, operations or support. The current Twilio messaging service uses its United States region. Australian database hosting does not mean every provider processes information only in Australia. Provider and telecommunications processing is subject to their applicable privacy terms and legal obligations. Disclosure to authorised staff, advisers or authorities is limited to service, security, dispute or legal purposes.

Our support/account mailbox uses Microsoft Exchange Online, purchased through GoDaddy with its listed email security service. We have not verified the mailbox's data-at-rest geography or every provider recovery, quarantine, backup or hold setting. We do not promise Australian-only processing or a fixed date when every provider-held copy is erased.

Sumsub provides hosted identity verification for withdrawal eligibility. The nominated payout bank and payment intermediaries process beneficiary and transfer details needed for an approved payment. Provider-held verification information, support access and transaction processing may involve overseas processing under the configured provider arrangements and their privacy terms; Australian database hosting does not establish Australian-only identity or banking processing. Closing a Docked account does not immediately delete every copy held by an identity provider, bank or intermediary.

sections.title: Device information and analytics
sections.text:
Network and security operations can involve IP addresses, device/request information and service logs. Optional first-party usage events require analytics consent and respect the browser's Do Not Track setting. Anonymous visitors are not assigned an identity by that observer. This does not mean hosting providers collect no operational information.

The app has no advertising SDK. Android and Google Play may provide operating-system diagnostics under their own settings.

The Android app also includes Google Play Billing Library. When the library is initialised or used, it sends billing-operation results, technical app/device information and a per-session identifier to Google for billing reliability, performance improvement and error support. This automatic SDK processing can occur without a completed purchase. It is separate from Docked's optional usage analytics and is not disabled by that analytics preference. Google handles this information under its own privacy terms.

Optional media selection and notification preferences follow device permissions and application controls. Contacts, microphone and location access are not required to buy a pack. We do not use identity documents or purchase tokens in Docked's optional usage analytics.

sections.title: Security
sections.text:
Docked uses HTTPS, access restrictions, rate limits, verification checks and privileged-account MFA. SMS is not end-to-end encrypted. Identity documents are submitted to the hosted verification provider rather than to Docked support. Provider results are checked on the server; a browser redirect or message is not accepted as identity approval. Bank destinations are encrypted at rest and access to full details is limited to authorised payout work. These safeguards do not eliminate every security risk.

Media and verification steps use the permissions relevant to the selected flow. Buying a pack does not require identity verification, access to contacts, a microphone or precise location. Withdrawal identity checks are separate from the checks required for ordinary account use. We do not use identity documents, bank-account details or purchase tokens in optional usage analytics.

sections.title: Phone and verification-message retention
sections.text: We retain the current account phone number while it is needed for account verification and security. Account deletion removes active account identifying information through the account-erasure process; necessary restricted evidence may remain for financial, security, dispute or legal purposes. Verification-message records are separate from the active account record. Twilio's published default makes message records available for 400 days and can retain older records in archives until deletion is requested or configured. After a message is deleted, Twilio says its body may remain in backups for up to 30 days. Telecommunications records and data held for independent legal or security purposes can have different retention periods. A code expiring does not delete the message or its delivery record. No automatic 90-day deletion of phone or SMS records is promised.

sections.title: Access, correction and account deletion
sections.text:
Request an export or deletion through Account settings or https://docked.com.au/account-deletion. If you cannot sign in, use account recovery or contact support. Authentication and proportionate checks protect these requests. Export and deletion requests do not require a withdrawal or a new identity check.

Deletion revokes account access and sessions first. The account-erasure process removes sign-in credentials and the active profile while preserving restricted records needed for financial, ownership, security, dispute or legal purposes. An opaque account reference linked to those records is not an active login and is not anonymous while still linkable. Account exports include your relevant identity status and withdrawal/payment history with masked destinations, not full bank-account details or identity document images.

A pending payout, refund/recovery exposure, provider-cleanup task or review of sensitive destination information can leave part of deletion pending. Access revocation is not represented as completion of every deletion task. Requests affecting provider-held identity, banking or verification-message records require assessment and coordination with the relevant provider. A recorded cleanup request does not mean that provider erasure has occurred. We explain which steps remain pending and which records are retained and why.

Historical beta records and previously accepted consent versions remain distinct. Deletion does not reverse completed card transfers, reset serial supply, cancel another member's rights or waive refund obligations.

sections.title: Financial records and ownership provenance
sections.text:
Necessary transaction, withdrawal, payment, refund and ownership records are retained for their documented financial, security, dispute and legal purposes. Company financial records are retained for at least seven years where required by Australian company law; this does not automatically apply to every identity document, profile field, phone number or bank detail. Retention of provider references and encrypted destination data must be reviewed for the relevant purpose, request and hold.

Minimal serial and ownership provenance can remain after account deletion to protect other owners and permanent supply. Still-linkable references are pseudonymous, not anonymous. Documented legal holds can extend the relevant period. Backups and provider-held records can follow separate schedules. Completed deletion restrictions must be reapplied before restored data returns to active use.

sections.title: Questions and complaints
sections.text: Contact support to request access or correction or raise a complaint. We will explain applicable restrictions and review options. This notice does not exclude non-excludable privacy or consumer rights. Privacy complaint information is available from the OAIC at https://www.oaic.gov.au/privacy/privacy-complaints. Previous accepted policy versions remain recorded; publication does not rewrite a past consent.

sections.title: Marketplace and seller-proceeds withdrawals
sections.text:
Marketplace listings show the seller's displayed identity, the card and its asking price to eligible members according to the Marketplace and blocking controls. Transaction history records the card, buyer and seller references, reviewed price, seller fee, ownership transfer and transaction outcome. A private receipt is available only to the relevant parties and authorised operations staff. Bank details, identity evidence, purchase verification references and withdrawal records are not public listings or ordinary counterparty information.

If you request a withdrawal, Sumsub receives the identity documents, selfie/liveness information and proof of residence you submit in its hosted verification flow. Review the provider's privacy notice before submitting them. Docked retrieves the result and the verified details needed to assess identity, adult/Australian eligibility and matching bank-account ownership. Docked does not upload or store the verification document images. We retain restricted verification status and reference records, review timestamps, eligibility outcomes and a protected name fingerprint; the verified name is used server-side for the destination review. A provider check is not a public profile badge.

Docked collects the nominated account-holder name, Australian BSB and bank-account number through the authenticated website to review the destination and arrange an approved payment. Sensitive destination details are encrypted in storage. Customer history and routine operations views show masked account details. Authorised staff obtain the details needed to execute or reconcile an approved payout, and the bank processes them for that transfer. We also retain request, review, reservation, payment, bank-reference, funding and refund/recovery evidence to prevent duplicate payments and resolve disputes. These records are not used in optional usage analytics.

documents.title: Purchases and refunds
documents.status: Google Play handles Android credit purchases. Marketplace seller proceeds and withdrawal requests have separate eligibility, funding and verification checks. Consumer rights and refund safeguards continue to apply.

sections.title: Current availability
sections.text:
Eligible Australian members aged 18 or over with verified accounts can purchase Docked Credits through Google Play and spend them on available card packs and fixed-price Marketplace purchases. The checkout identifies the price and credit amount before confirmation. Purchased credits cannot be voluntarily withdrawn as cash. TEST purchases, beta credits, promotional/test allocations and isolated inventory do not become withdrawable seller proceeds.

Only eligible settled card-sale proceeds may support a separate withdrawal request through the Docked website, subject to the current policy, identity and bank verification, available backing funds and financial/recovery holds. A displayed credit balance is not automatically an amount available for withdrawal. Paid competition entry and prizes remain unavailable.

sections.title: Credit packages and pack contents
sections.text:
Google Play credit packages are A$49 for 4,900 Docked Credits and A$99 for 9,900, with no bonus credits. These Australian dollar prices include 10% GST; no extra GST is added at checkout. No separate charge is made when freely granted test credits are issued. Google checkout displays the current price before confirmation. Credits can be used for NFL, AFL or NRL packs. Packs are priced in credits.

Standard packs: 1 card for 100 credits; 3 for 300; 9 for 700. Premium packs: 1 card for 700 credits; 3 for 1,900; 9 for 5,000. A 9-card pack delivers nine permanent digital cards in one successful fulfilment. Review the sport, exact card count, price and available balance before confirming. A 4,900-credit package alone does not cover a 5,000-credit Premium 9-card pack.

For each Standard card slot, the rarity probabilities are Rare 85%, Elite 12%, Ultra Rare 2.5%, Legendary 0.49% and Icon 0.01%. For each Premium card slot, they are Ultra Rare 90%, Legendary 9.9% and Icon 0.1%. Core cards are excluded. These are probabilities for each card slot, not a guarantee of any rarity or player in a pack. A pack contains no duplicate player. If the required eligible supply cannot support the complete pack, the purchase fails without a partial debit or partial delivery; probabilities are not silently substituted. Repeating a completed request does not debit or deliver twice.

Supply limits apply permanently per player and rarity across issuances: Core unlimited; Rare 5,000; Elite 2,500; Ultra Rare 400; Legendary 50; Icon 1. Existing legitimate issued copies consume these limits. Transfers, refunds and a player leaving a roster do not reset lifetime issuance. Cards are digital entitlements within Docked, not investments or ownership of a player, trademark or copyright. No particular player, resale value or financial return is guaranteed.

sections.title: Requesting help or a refund
sections.text:
For a Google Play purchase issue, contact support@docked.com.au and use Google Play's purchase-support options. Include an order reference if available; do not send passwords, identity documents or full payment details. Legitimate Google purchase refunds follow Google's original-payment-method refund process; a withdrawal request is not a substitute for that process.

Refunds and remedies remain subject to applicable consumer rights. Opening a pack or completing a later card sale does not by itself remove rights that cannot be excluded. We do not impose a blanket no-refunds rule.

sections.title: Payment and refund safety
sections.text:
A pending or declined purchase does not provide spendable credits. The server verifies purchase state and the associated member before fulfilment. Repeated requests must not credit a purchase twice.

When Google confirms a refund or revocation, Docked reverses the remaining credits from that purchase once. If credits have already been spent, the account can enter a recovery hold: affected spending or transfers may be restricted while support reviews the purchase, spending and refund records. Your history remains available. A hold is not an automatic bank charge, a negative spendable balance, debt collection or permission to take another member's cards. It does not remove consumer-law remedies.

Contact support@docked.com.au to dispute a hold, correct a mistaken account association or provide relevant refund evidence. Support must verify the purchase and record the reason for any resolution. No automatic charge or unrelated-card clawback is authorised by this policy. TEST orders and commercial purchases remain separate.

sections.title: Consumer safeguards
sections.text: Unopened packs, completed openings and later card transfers are reviewed using the actual purchase evidence and applicable consumer law. There is no blanket forfeiture or no-refund rule. Opening a pack does not remove rights that cannot be excluded. Beta credits, cards and unopened packs do not become usable commercial assets. Their original ownership provenance, financial records and lifetime supply consumption remain preserved as historical records. Retirement does not waive statutory rights, reclaim serials or automatically clear a refund or recovery hold.

sections.title: Seller proceeds and payment outcomes
sections.text:
Seller proceeds retain the funding references of the buyer's credits. A refund, chargeback, provider adjustment or funding discrepancy can therefore affect whether proceeds are available for withdrawal. Pending settlement, a financial/recovery hold, an existing reservation or unavailable backing funds can prevent a new request even where the credits remain visible. This is not authority for an automatic bank debit, debt collection or confiscation of an unrelated member's cards.

A withdrawal request reserves the selected eligible proceeds so they cannot also be spent or requested twice. Cancellation or rejection before payment releases the applicable reservation. Once payment is in progress or its outcome is uncertain, support must reconcile it before releasing funds or attempting another payment. A payment confirmed unpaid or returned restores the corresponding credits and withdrawal fee through the recorded reconciliation process. Completed payments and later refunds retain their history and are resolved with audited adjustments; they are not silently deleted or paid twice.

documents.title: Retention and deletion
documents.status: Current service targets and prepared commercial retention controls. Automated billing minimisation is disabled until separately configured and verified.

sections.title: Existing handling targets
sections.text: The existing beta policy targets removal of eligible account/contact details and posts/media within 30 days of verified closure. Access is revoked first. Account-to-game identity links are targeted for removal within 30 days after relevant rounds or disputes close. Minimized ownership/scoring evidence is reviewed at beta end and deleted or further de-identified within 12 months of beta closure unless a documented exception remains. These are handling targets, not a claim that every provider automatically erases every copy by that date.

sections.title: Operational and support records
sections.text: Existing targets are removal of routine support cases from the active mailbox 12 months after closure, and exported working copies after delivery verification within seven days. Routine operational logs have a maximum target of 30 days and security logs 90 days. Exceptional incident/dispute evidence requires a recorded reason and review at least every 90 days. These targets apply to records Docked controls; individual provider settings and legal holds must be checked.

sections.title: Exceptions, backups and pending deletion
sections.text:
Ongoing competitions, disputes, documented incidents or applicable obligations may require limited records for longer. Record the reason and review date and limit access. Permanent supply and scoring integrity do not justify retaining names or email addresses indefinitely. Still-linkable records are not anonymous.

Recovery, quarantine, backups and holds can preserve copies after active deletion. Relevant restrictions need review for each request. Completed deletion requests must be reapplied before restored data returns to active use. The current shared beta identity requires operator review for identity erasure. Failed erasure steps remain pending rather than being reported complete.

sections.title: Public commercial release
sections.text:
Financial records required by Australian company law must be kept for at least seven years after the transactions covered are completed. This does not require every profile field, document or routine log to be kept for seven years. Records subject to an active dispute, recovery case or legal hold remain restricted and under review; expiry of a review date does not automatically release a hold.

The prepared billing worker minimizes completed notification/retry records after 90 days, with an encrypted recovery archive for a further 30 days. Minimal notification identifiers remain to reject replay. It does not delete financial journals, ownership history or purchase verification references. The worker is not yet active. Purchase references are access-restricted for verification, refund/replay prevention and dispute handling; the final deletion point must be documented against the applicable provider and legal requirements before automated erasure. These records are not described as anonymous while still linkable.

Retention controls do not erase all provider backups or mailbox copies. Contact support@docked.com.au for the records and reasons applicable to your deletion request. We will not call a pending or held step complete.

sections.title: Identity and withdrawal records
sections.text:
Identity review references and outcomes, protected name fingerprints, encrypted nominated bank details and withdrawal/payment records have separate purposes and retention reviews. Docked does not store the identity document images submitted to the verification provider. Active withdrawal, return, refund, recovery, dispute or legal obligations may require restricted evidence to remain after account access is revoked. Account deletion can therefore leave financial and provider-cleanup tasks pending.

The retention review records the reason and next review point for retained information. A queued provider-cleanup task is not confirmation that a provider has erased its records. Banks, identity providers and intermediaries can retain information for their own contractual, security or legal purposes. No new universal deletion deadline or automatic erasure of every provider copy is promised. Contact support for the status and reasons applicable to your request.

documents.title: Marketplace and withdrawal terms
documents.status: Australian adult commercial service with fixed-price card trading and eligible seller-proceeds withdrawals subject to current availability and the checks below. This notice does not guarantee that new transactions are available at every time.

sections.title: Service scope
sections.text:
Docked offers NFL, AFL and NRL digital collectible cards to eligible Australian residents aged 18 or over. Public accounts require verified email and an Australian mobile number, with one verified phone number linked to one Docked account. Phone verification establishes control of a number; it does not prove residency or identity. Withdrawal requests require separate hosted identity and nominated bank-account checks. NBA, paid competition entry and prizes remain unavailable.

Purchased Docked Credits are for use within Docked and cannot be voluntarily withdrawn. Only proceeds from eligible settled card sales may be assessed for withdrawal under the current schedule and funding controls. TEST orders, test/beta credits and test inventory remain separate and have no cash withdrawal entitlement.

sections.title: Gameplay and collections
sections.text: The six competition entries are labelled Practice and remain disabled. Real scored competitions and associated statistics are not enabled until their permissions and release checks are complete. Card ownership does not activate a competition or guarantee any game result. Commercial collections display cards legitimately acquired through the commercial service. Historical beta cards, credits, packs, teams and rankings do not carry into commercial participation. Their original issuance, serials, custody and financial history remain protected historical records; permanent supply is never replenished by retirement.

sections.title: Packs and marketplace
sections.text:
Standard and Premium packs follow the prices, contents and rarity probabilities shown before purchase and in the Purchases and refunds notice. Successful fulfilment records cards and serials atomically. Opening the reveal displays cards already allocated to the account; retrying a completed request does not create extra copies. No particular player, sale price, resale value, financial return or ability to withdraw is guaranteed.

When the Marketplace is open, eligible members can list and purchase an already-issued eligible card at a fixed price in Docked Credits. The buyer pays the listed price. The seller fee is 5% of that price, rounded half up to whole credits and capped at 2,000 credits, with no minimum fee. The review shows the exact price, fee and seller net before confirmation. A completed sale moves the existing card and serial and records the corresponding credits once.

Ownership, financial/recovery holds, blocks, account eligibility, a card lock or a changed listing can prevent settlement. Repricing requires a fresh price review. Completed sale receipts remain available to the parties. Swaps, mixed offers, direct credit gifts, auctions, peer-to-peer cash transfers and exports of cards outside Docked are unavailable. The Marketplace can stop accepting new settlements while retaining completed sale records and refund obligations.

sections.title: Account and community rules
sections.text: Use your own account, accurate eligibility information and the normal confirmation/security procedures. Do not evade access restrictions, impersonate others, exploit purchases or harass members. Existing reporting, blocking and moderation controls apply. No new privacy consent or previously accepted policy is silently replaced by this publication.

sections.title: Rights and service restrictions
sections.text: Docked uses verified player identities and original generic card artwork. No affiliation or endorsement by players, clubs or leagues is implied. Professional names do not confer rights to official photographs, logos, protected artwork or proprietary statistics. Required source acknowledgements are provided through the source notices. NBA, real scored competitions, paid entry, prizes, swaps and offers remain unavailable unless separately released. Consumer rights that cannot be excluded continue to apply. Contact support@docked.com.au for a transaction, withdrawal, hold or account request.

sections.title: Clean commercial starting position
sections.text: Beta credits and card allocations are historical testing records. They do not become commercial balances, usable commercial cards, paid packs, active teams, rankings or marketplace assets. Ordinary beta customers re-register themselves; retained Owners also start commercial participation at zero. Historical card issuance remains permanently counted against each player’s rarity limit. A protected entitlement raised before retirement is reviewed individually; the transition does not waive statutory rights or automatically clear a refund or recovery hold.

sections.title: Withdrawals from eligible sale proceeds
sections.text:
Request a withdrawal through the authenticated Docked website. The withdrawal page shows whether new requests are available and displays the current Australian-dollar conversion rate, minimum and maximum request, daily limit, any fee and net amount before confirmation. The rate and fee come from the active withdrawal schedule; the pack-purchase exchange rate is not a promise of a withdrawal rate. You must review and accept the displayed version for the request.

Eligibility is limited to settled card-sale proceeds with verified funding, sufficient available backing and no conflicting reservation or financial/recovery hold. Purchased credits cannot be withdrawn merely by asking support, and test/beta balances never become cash balances. Selling a card does not guarantee that the resulting credit balance is immediately eligible.

Complete the hosted identity flow and nominate an Australian bank account in your verified legal name. A typed account name or identity-provider approval alone does not verify bank ownership. Docked separately reviews the beneficiary evidence. The approved identity and destination must still be current for the request and payment; a change can require a new review. Do not provide identity documents or full bank details through email, community messages or a Marketplace counterparty.

Submitting a request reserves the selected proceeds against double spending and duplicate withdrawals. A request or approval is not evidence that a bank payment has been made. Payment and reconciliation statuses reflect the recorded outcome. Payout timing depends on the review, available funds, bank processing and any hold; no fixed completion time is promised.

Cancel an eligible request before payment begins using the displayed controls. A rejected or cancelled unpaid request releases its reservation. An in-progress or uncertain payment must be reconciled before a retry or release. When a payment is confirmed unpaid or returned, the corresponding credits and withdrawal fee are restored through the recorded process. Completed payments, later disputes and funding refunds are handled with retained evidence and audited adjustments. Neither turning off new requests nor deleting an account removes existing payment or refund obligations.
